buildCommand: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && curl -sLJO "https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.140.2/hugo_extended_0.140.2_Linux-64bit.tar.gz" && tar -C "$HOME/.local/bin" -xf "hugo_extended_0.140.2_Linux-64bit.tar.gz" && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && hugo --gc --minify --buildFuture
